shipping.title: Shipping & returns
shipping.intro: We deliver to every governorate in Egypt. Pay by card, mobile wallet, or cash on delivery.
shipping.noZones: Shipping fees are shown at checkout.
shipping.customBody: Every custom design is checked by our team before printing, so custom orders take 1–2 extra days.
shipping.returnsBody: Ready-made tees can be returned within 14 days if unworn and unwashed. Custom designs are printed just for you, so they can only be returned if they arrive damaged or misprinted.

items.q1: How does the AI Design Studio work?
items.a1: Type an idea or upload a photo, and our AI turns it into a bold sticker-style print. Move it, resize it, and add it to your cart.
items.q2: Can I pay cash on delivery?
items.a2: Yes. You can pay cash on delivery anywhere in Egypt, or pay online by card or mobile wallet.
items.a3: Usually 2–4 days for ready-made tees. Custom designs take 1–2 extra days because we check and print each one.
items.a4: Check the size guide. If your kid is between two sizes, pick the bigger one.
items.a5: Uploaded photos are private, used only to make your design, and deleted after 30 days if no order uses them.
items.q6: Can I put a cartoon character or a brand logo on a tee?
items.a6: No — we can only print original designs, so the studio blocks known characters, brands and logos.
